note: The keepsake and net one-shots (docs/future/12): recorded CC0 takes in assets/audio/one-shots/keepsakes/, each peaked at -3 dBFS, played on the tools bus. db sets each one's level; pitchCents is a small seeded spread so a sound heard often is never quite the same twice. wakeWaitMs is how long a sound waits for the page's first tap to wake the sound before it gives up. Sources are in assets/audio/CREDITS.md. Fishing (docs/future/17, until CC0 takes of its own) borrows these takes, quieter and higher (cents, a take's own pitch): fish-cast the swish of the cast, fish-plip the float landing, fish-dip the float going under, fish-reel the line coming in, fish-release the fish slipping back, fish-flop the fish on the line.
